subject: operations-research
intro: Operations research is the mathematics of better decisions, and organisations pay well for it — analysts who squeeze cost out of networks, queues and schedules sit inside airlines, logistics giants, hospitals and consultancies.

roles.title: Operations Research Analysts
roles.what: Formulate and apply mathematical modelling and other optimising methods to develop and interpret information that assists management decisionmaking, and may build decision-support software or optimal time, cost and logistics networks.
roles.where: This course is the profession's core curriculum: the simplex method, duality and sensitivity, network flows, integer programming and dynamic programming are exactly the techniques analysts deploy, sharpened by the queuing and simulation unit.

roles.title: Mathematicians
roles.what: Conduct research in fundamental mathematics or in applying mathematical techniques to science, management and other fields, solving problems across industries with mathematical methods.
roles.where: The convexity, KKT conditions and duality work in the nonlinear optimisation unit, and the Markov decision processes in the probability models unit, are graduate-level mathematics applied — the natural continuation of this syllabus into research roles.

roles.title: Statisticians
roles.what: Develop or apply mathematical and statistical theory to collect, organise, interpret and summarise numerical data into usable information, specialising in areas such as business, biostatistics or economic statistics.
roles.where: The Poisson processes, queueing theory and Monte Carlo methods in the probability and simulation units give statisticians their stochastic modelling backbone, while decision-tree analysis adds the interpretation layer clients ask for.

roles.title: Data Scientists
roles.what: Transform raw data into meaningful information using data-oriented programming languages, applying data mining, data modelling, natural language processing and machine learning, then visualising, interpreting and reporting the findings.
roles.where: The optimisation units supply the algorithms behind machine-learning training and routing engines, and the simulation and decision analysis unit's Monte Carlo and multi-objective methods are the toolbox for model evaluation and reporting.

roles.title: Management Analysts
roles.what: Conduct organisational studies and evaluations, design systems and procedures, carry out work simplification and measurement studies, and prepare operations and procedures manuals that help management run more efficiently — the job includes management consulting.
roles.where: Queueing theory and simulation tell you where capacity and waiting waste money; decision analysis with utility and multi-objective trade-offs structures the recommendations; sensitivity analysis from the LP unit stress-tests every proposal.
